Docket 1.3.124

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *Topic suggestions no longer come from your business's name.* With no topic typed, Docket works out what a site is
  about from its pages. For a business whose name was the only thing its pages had in common, it took a word from
  the name as the subject and suggested articles about something else entirely. A word now counts only if the site
  also uses it in its own words; when nothing qualifies, Docket says so instead of guessing.
- *Empty pages are reported as empty pages.* Several pages with nothing in them but the site's menu and footer were
  described as a response a rate limiter or bot filter hands out. Pages that each carry their own title are now
  judged as the site's own pages, and reported as having almost no content.
- *An insecure frame is called a frame.* A page embedding another page over http:// was said to load "scripts or
  styles". The finding now names what it found (scripts, stylesheets or embedded frames) and quotes one with its
  page.
- *When a site's own errors cut an audit short, the report says so.* When most of what Docket could not read came
  back as server errors, the first finding now names them as the cause and says to fix them first, instead of
  listing a blocked crawler among the possibilities.

99 checks across 13 areas.
